design_condition: The compact building is well inserted into its surroundings with good distance from neighbouring buildings, while its access is organized through a compact, structured arrival sequence.

positive.statement: The project is compact and well inserted into the surrounding context, with good distance from other buildings.

position.rationale: The compact rectangular footprint and consistent four-storey elevations are clearly visible across all views.

positive.statement: The compact access via Mola is very interesting and well structured.

position.rationale: Mola is not represented; the lower-left perimeter is used as a constrained access-facing anchor.

positive.statement: The ground floor brilliantly resolves the height constraints of a four-storey building through differentiated and convincing spatial events.

position.rationale: The lowest elevation band is clearly sampled, while differentiated ground-floor events remain only partially legible.

positive.statement: The classroom plans develop the space program coherently, modularly, and flexibly.

position.rationale: Classrooms are interior and not distinguishable; an upper-floor peripheral zone provides a plausible anchor.

positive.statement: The project is the most convincing in developing the client's concept of new school teaching.

position.rationale: The educational concept applies broadly, anchored to the visible upper building mass rather than a specific room.

positive.statement: The construction method has good potential for containing costs and construction times.

position.rationale: Cost and construction-time potential are whole-project judgments not spatially represented in the point cloud.

positive.statement: The project presents the best potential for possible certification in the field.

position.rationale: Certification potential is an unlocated sustainability judgment.

negative.statement: A different solution for bicycle parking would be sensible.

position.rationale: Bicycle parking is absent from the sample; the southern peripheral site zone is a constrained approximation.
